You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

🍲 A man, maybe 50s, with a crooked nose eats quiet by the fire, scraping the bowl clean with their thumb.

A man, maybe 50s, with weathered hands is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 83/100)

Adaeze and Zulfikar lingered over the fire together.

— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

Wolfgang Silverman reads the sky: rain tomorrow, cold.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A person, maybe 60s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 50s, with a slouched posture watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
A person, maybe 50s, with a slouched posture looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A person, maybe 20s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 50s, with a slouched posture doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Zulfikar," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Zulfikar." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Zulfikar).
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 60s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
